provenance: Display annotations of existing coded meanings; no duration or source change. Checked 22 November 2026.

kind_permissions.school: School education before the selected university-entry route; no medical practice licence.
kind_permissions.prerequisite: Prior undergraduate study; no medical practice licence.
kind_permissions.degree: Medical education and its assessments; this stage alone is not a medical practice licence.
kind_permissions.clinical: Supervised clinical training; completion and registration conditions apply.
kind_permissions.specialty: Training towards the named GP or family-medicine qualification; credential conditions still apply.
kind_permissions.exam: Required examination or assessment; passing alone does not issue a licence or qualification.
kind_permissions.embedded: Requirement already included within the course or training; no extra time is added.
kind_permissions.later_role: Experience towards insured-facility management eligibility, with alternatives and transition rules.
kind_permissions.practice_endpoint: Training or practice eligibility milestone; the stated local conditions apply.

routes.india: MBBS → internship → optional MD Family Medicine

ca-first.permits: Approved postgraduate residency training; not a general medical licence.

ca-full.permits: General medical licence, subject to examination, training and renewal conditions; family-medicine residency can still be unfinished.

ca-family-ready.permits: Residency completion; Board certification also requires examination and other conditions. This is later than initial general medical licensure.

en-first.permits: Supervised practice in an approved Foundation Year 1 post only.

en-full.permits: Full medical registration; entry on the GP register requires the separate GP route.

en-gp-ready.permits: GP-specific endpoint after ten years from school leaving; additional registration and listing conditions apply.

de-full.permits: General medical licence subject to statutory conditions; GP specialist recognition is separate.

de-first.permits: Medical licence subject to application and statutory conditions; GP specialist recognition is separate.

de-gp-ready.permits: Qualification endpoint after 11.25 post-school years; statutory-insurance admission and practice permissions are not modelled as automatic.

jp-first.permits: Medical licence; the initial clinical-training duty still applies.

jp-full.permits: Medical licence; at least two years of designated clinical training are required for physicians intending clinical practice.

jp-gp-ready.permits: Family/general-practice training endpoint at eleven post-school years on this selected minimum route; specialist certification also requires the Board examination.

in-first.permits: Supervised internship only, following the academic-phase pass certificate.

in-full.permits: Independent general medical practice subject to registration conditions; not a specialist qualification.

in-family-ready.permits: Selected family-medicine qualification endpoint after eight and a half post-school years. Current admission availability, service obligations and award administration are not modelled.

sg-first.permits: Supervised PGY1 work in approved hospitals only.

sg-full.permits: General medical practice subject to full-registration conditions; family-physician accreditation is separate.

sg-family-ready.permits: Family-medicine training endpoint at nine post-school years. A relevant qualification, recognised FM experience and currency of practice are separate accreditation conditions.
